question: Who ignited the spark of freedom that led to the revolt of 1857?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mangal Pandey.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mangal Pandey** ignited the spark of freedom that led to the **revolt of 1857. **
 
• The major cause of the revolt was the fact that the **cartridges** of the new** Enfield rifles were greased with the fat of cows and pigs.**
 
• Before loading these rifles the sepoys had to** bite off the paper **on the cartridges. Both **Hindu and Muslim** sepoys** refused to use them.**
 
• Other reasons were** British policies **of heavy taxation, west-driven educational, social, and social reforms, 
 
• The revolt **started from Merrut **and later spread across different parts of the country.
